name: kaizentrace-workspace
description: KaizenTrace - Evidence-Based Software Incident Investigation Tool with Integrated TeamFlow Demo Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "tf-be,tf-fe,kt-be,kt-fe" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev:teamflow:backend" "npm run dev:teamflow:frontend" "npm run dev:kaizentrace:backend" "npm run dev:kaizentrace:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/teamflow/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/teamflow/frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/kaizentrace/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/kaizentrace/frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:teamflow && npm run test:kaizentrace

author: KaizenTrace
